title.provenance: An act to add Sections 108981, 108981.5, and 108982 to the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

location.provenance: The people of the State of California

status.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

date.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Beginning January 1, 2025, no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally added PFAS means either of the following: (1) PFAS chemicals that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect on the product.
